name: Mob na Jimiko ga Shuyaku-kyuu no Dohentai ~Ore ja Nakattara Minogashiteita ne~
original_name: モブな地味娘が主役級のド変態～俺じゃなかったら見逃していたね～
source:
“Miki Aota”
I keep an eye on girls I’d like to hook up with, but she never even crossed my mind.
She’s plain-looking and has no distinguishing features. She’s what you’d call a background character.

But my classmates are constantly talking to her. It’s surprising, considering she’s so plain and doesn’t seem to have many friends.
I thought that for a moment, but I immediately sensed something was off. She’s just being used as a scapegoat to offload troublesome tasks.
To everyone else, Aota is a “convenient girl”—
She must be the type who’s easily swayed and can’t say no when asked insistently.

(Wait a minute… this girl could be useful…!)

If I push her hard enough, maybe I can turn her into my sex slave.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015599.html/]dlsite[/url]]
